コンテスト情報

  • コンテスト時間: 100 分
  • レーティング更新対象: 0 - 1999

AtCoder Beginner Contest (ABC) は、初心者でも気軽に参加できるコンテストです。

配点

問題 点数
A 100
B 200

D 400
E 450
F 500

ルール

  1. コンテスト中に問題に正解すると点数を獲得できます。
  2. 順位は総合得点で決定します。
  3. 同点の場合は提出時間の早い人が上の順位になります。
  4. 誤答を提出するたびにペナルティが加算されます。このコンテストのペナルティは5分です。詳細は画面下部の「ルール」をご覧ください。

このコンテストは full-feedback 形式のコンテストです。コンテスト中に提出された結果だけで順位が決定します。

Promote Your Company through AtCoder Contests

AtCoder is one of the world's largest competitive programming platforms, with over 900,000 registered users worldwide. Our contests attract thousands of highly skilled programmers, students, and engineers.

Sponsorship Benefits

  • Introduce your company on the contest page
  • Post a link to your recruitment or corporate website
  • Reach talented programmers around the world
  • Receive participant information only from users who agree to provide it to the sponsor

AtCoder offers several contest formats, including AtCoder Beginner Contest (ABC), AtCoder Regular Contest (ARC), and AtCoder Heuristic Contest (AHC).

If you are interested in sponsoring an AtCoder contest, please note that communication will be conducted via text-based communication, such as e-mail or chat.

For more details, please visit: AtCoderContest.pdf

Contest Rules

This contest is full-feedback (solutions are judged during the contest).
When you solve a problem, you get a score assigned to it. Competitors are ranked first by total scores, then by penalties. The penalties are computed as (the time you spend to get your current score) + (5 minutes) * (the number of incorrect attempts).
